standard_prerequisites.name: Projectivity of blowing up for locally Noetherian schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Divisors, the lemma that blowing up is projective in the locally Noetherian case
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives properness of the blowing up morphism.

standard_prerequisites.name: Nagata property is preserved under finite type morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, the lemma on the Nagata property for schemes of finite type over a Nagata base
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the blowup is Nagata.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finiteness of normalization for Nagata schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, the lemma that the normalization of a Nagata scheme is finite, and the lemma that the normalization is normal
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives finiteness and normality of the normalization step, hence properness of the composite.

core_obligations: Properness and the Nagata property (proof lines 1248-1257): the blowing up morphism is proper because the scheme is locally Noetherian, so the blowup is Nagata; the normalization of a Nagata scheme is finite, and composing a finite morphism with a proper one is proper, so the normalized blowup is proper over the original scheme.
Normality (proof lines 1257-1266): the normalization is normal by construction, which completes the list of asserted properties.
proof_roadmap: Get properness of the blowing up and the Nagata property of its source.
Apply finiteness of normalization to obtain properness of the composite.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a Nagata scheme the normalized blowing up at a point is normal, Nagata and proper over the scheme (statement lines 1244-1248). The proof (proof lines 1249-1266) combines properness of blowing up, preservation of the Nagata property, and finiteness of normalization. H2: a complete short argument.
